thread:
maria: quick q — how do `stop` sequences interact with `max_tokens` and sampling params when streaming + `logprobs`? e.g. if a stop matches mid-token do we still return that token's logprobs? which wins if stop and max_tokens happen at the same time? ping @kevin @ash
kevin: short: stop wins. runtime applies stops against the decoded text and truncates output when a stop is matched. we try to include logprobs for the last fully emitted token; partial/subword matches don't produce separate partial-token logprobs. v1 behavior was a bit inconsistent for edge cases.
ash: (minor) tagging @kevin -> afaik we also emit a final metadata frame for streaming with a `truncated_by` field set to either `stop` or `max_tokens`. that helps clients decide if they should retry or post-process.
ash: oh—also, sampling params (temp/top_p) don't change precedence; they only affect token selection. but they can affect whether a stop is reached earlier or later because generation differs.
ash: sorry typo, that's @ash (me)
ash: recommended test snippet: ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "prompt": "Hello\n",
  "max_tokens": 5,
  "stop": ["\n\n"],
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 0.9,
  "logprobs": 3
}
```
ash: expected: final streaming event includes `truncated_by: "stop"` when the decoded string ends with the stop sequence, and `logprobs` contains the last emitted token's probs (no partial-token entries). add a test that forces stop mid-subword to confirm behavior.
lina: small SDK note — streaming clients should not assume every delta contains `logprobs`; only final frame guarantees last-token metadata. recommend SDK exposes `truncated_by` and `stop_sequence` fields on final event.
oliver: agree with lina. also, if stop & max_tokens coincide (both triggered at same token), prefer `truncated_by: "stop"` (explicit is better). we'll add that to contract.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/stop-truncation-fix canary @ 2024-06-14T22:30:00Z :rocket:
maria: perfect — i'll add tests + doc update for the API contract. @ash can you review wording for the `truncated_by` enum?
ash: will do, adding a tiny RFC in docs repo and a unit test in runtime tests.
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: Async q&a: clarify stop vs max_tokens precedence in streaming with logprobs; stop wins, include last full-token logprobs, add truncated_by metadata; tests + SDK notes planned
